name: clawd

provenance.by: annotated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) from the sheet
provenance.method: looked at the model sheet's four figures (full views and 2-3x crops) and at the 2D rig's layer images; a reading by eye, no measurement and no API call

conventions.side: her own side: L = her left (the image's right in the front view), R = her right, C = centre
conventions.rig: the rig layer the piece is drawn in (the rig names layers by the image's side: its sleeve_L is her right sleeve)
conventions.bone: VRM humanoid bone the piece rides on
conventions.motion: rigid (follows a bone) / spring (needs a chain) / cloth (a hanging sheet round the body)
conventions.views: sheet figures the piece shows in

notes: The back panels read as two tails split at the centre back: the generated 3D shape parts there, and the sheet's back view shows the shorts between them under a higher centre hem.
The rig draws the cream bib into its bow layer (between the tails), not into the bodice layer.
The single upright lock (ahoge) and the hair's locks are hair, not outfit pieces.
The wrist cuffs' cream top edge is stepped like the hems (a notch at the front); the sleeve cuffs are plain bands.
